title: Find a Charleston show and share it
description: Instructional walkthrough of the events calendar on a phone: search a city, open the Charleston calendar, narrow to This Weekend, open the featured show, tap Going, point at Get Tickets, and share it. Seeds a fictional Charleston weekend at real public venues, dated relative to the rig clock. Doubles as the regression for that path; demo mode renders it as a captioned MP4 (extrachill-network#328).
